profile.title: Túr profile
profile.description: How you show up across the app. Túr avatar and name appear in the header, sidebar, and anywhere your teammates see you.
profile.photoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP, or GIF. Up to 2 MB.
profile.emailChangeHint: Check the inbox for <bold>{oldCorreo}</bold> and <bold>{newCorreo}</bold> — both need to confirm before the change takes effect.
profile.unsupportedImageDesc: Use PNG, JPG, WebP, or GIF.
profile.profileSavedEmailCheck: Profile Guardard — check your email to confirm the address change
profile.passwordDesc: Use at least {min} characters. Tú will stay signed in on this device after changing it.
profile.cannotChangeNoEmail: Cannot change password without a current email
profile.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {min} characters
profile.passwordMismatch: Nuevo password and confirmation do not match
profile.sessionsDesc: Sign out of every device where you're logged in — including this one. Useful if you lost a laptop or shared your password.
profile.signOutConfirmDesc: Every device logged into this account will be signed out and will need to log in again. Tú will be redirected to the login page.

appearance.title: Apariencia
appearance.description: Set the mode and accent colour used across the app. Guardard to this device — try it, it changes live.

security.title: Login & security
security.description: Change your password and sign out of your devices. These keep your account safe.

apiKeys.title: Claves API
apiKeys.description: Keys authenticate the public REST API (<apiCode>/api/v1</apiCode>) so you can build your own automations. Enviar them as <headerCode>Authorization: Bearer <key></headerCode>.
apiKeys.createOneHint: Click <bold>Nuevo API key</bold> to create one.
apiKeys.askAdminHint: Ask an admin to create one.
apiKeys.loadFailed: No se pudo load API keys
apiKeys.scopesHint: A key with no scopes can still call GET /api/v1/me to verify it works.
apiKeys.copyDesc: This is the only time the full key is shown. Store it somewhere safe — if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.copyFailed: No se pudo copiar — select and copy manually
apiKeys.newKeyDesc: Nombre it after the integration that will use it, and grant only the scopes it needs.
apiKeys.networkError: No se pudo reach the server

deals.title: Oportunidades y moneda
deals.description: The currency used for new deals and for pipeline and dashboard totals.
deals.defaultCurrencyDesc: Nuevo deals default to this currency, and pipeline and dashboard totals are shown in it. Existing deals keep the currency they were Guardard with.
deals.adminOnlyHint: Only account admins can change the default currency.
deals.saveFailed: No se pudo Guardar default currency

aiConfig.title: Agent setup
aiConfig.description: Bring your own AbrirIA or Anthropic key. wacrm calls the provider directly with your key — no per-seat IA fees, and your data stays yours. This powers IA-drafted replies in the inbox, the auto-reply bot, and the Playground.
aiConfig.adminOnlyConfig: Only admins and owners can change the IA configuration.
aiConfig.loadFailed: No se pudo load IA configuration
aiConfig.encryptionNotice: Túr key is encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never shown again after saving.
aiConfig.testNetworkError: No se pudo reach the provider.
aiConfig.embeddingsHint: An AbrirIA key used only to embed your knowledge base (text-embedding-3-small){sameKeyTexto}. Leave blank to use keyword search instead. Clear it to turn semantic search off.
aiConfig.sameKeyText: — can be the same key as above
aiConfig.behaviourDesc: Tell the assistant about your business — products, tone, what it may and may not promise. This context feeds both drafts and auto-replies.
aiConfig.promptPlaceholder: e.g. We are Acme, a coffee-equipment store. Be warm and concise. Never quote prices or delivery dates — hand off to a human for those.
aiConfig.enableAssistantDesc: Master switch. Turns on the “Borrador with IA” button in the inbox.
aiConfig.autoReply: Responder automáticamente a los mensajes entrantes
aiConfig.autoReplyDesc: The bot answers new inbound messages automatically (only when no flow handles them and no agent is assigned). Hands off to a human when it can’t help.
aiConfig.maxAutoRepliesDesc: After this many bot replies in one thread, the bot goes quiet.
aiConfig.handoffToDesc: When the bot can’t help — or hits the reply cap — it pauses and routes the chat here, with a short note on what happened.
aiConfig.handoffQueue: Sin asignar queue (any agent can pick it up)

aiKnowledge.title: Base de conocimiento
aiKnowledge.description: Agregar FAQs, policies, or product details. The assistant retrieves the relevant pieces when drafting and auto-replying, so it can answer instead of handing off.{searchTipo}
aiKnowledge.semanticSearchOn: Semantic search is on (embeddings key set).
aiKnowledge.keywordSearchOn: Using keyword search — add an embeddings key above for semantic search.
aiKnowledge.editDocContentPlaceholder: Paste the FAQ answer, policy text, or product details…
aiKnowledge.reindexTooltip: Re-embed all documents (e.g. after adding an embeddings key)
